thread:
Maya: Heads up — new customer 'Orion' onboarding. They want private deployment with Dedicated GPUs and cross-account peering to a partner analytics VPC. Need quotas + network plan.

Sam: TL;DR what do we need from infra?

Maya: Primary asks: 1) GPU quota increase (A100 80GB) in us-west3 and eu-west1 for Dedicated pools. 2) ENI / private IP limits for large node groups. 3) NAT egress capacity (EIPs) + PrivateLink endpoint quotas. 4) Peering with partner account (cidr overlap check). 5) Subnet sizing for multi-AZ, future scale to 200 GPUs.

Raj: Can you drop a CIDR/subnet proposal and exact GPU numbers? Also where do they want control plane (hosted vs customer-managed)?

Maya: They're doing Private with our control plane in their VPC (customer-managed network). Preliminary numbers: want 64 A100-80GB reserved initially, burst to 96. For region split: 48 in us-west3, 16 in eu-west1 (pilot), reserve capacity for AZ failover.

Priya: For k8s node density we typically assume 1 GPU per node for A100-80 on our runtime. ENI/ip planning: on AWS p-type instances each ENI has limited IPs. Recommend /19 per AZ to be safe. Example proposal:
```
VPC: 10.40.0.0/16
AZ subnets: 10.40.0.0/19 (us-west3a)
             10.40.32.0/19 (us-west3b)
             10.40.64.0/19 (us-west3c)
K8s service CIDR: 100.64.0.0/13
Pod CIDR: 100.128.0.0/16
```
This gives ~8190 IPs per AZ block, headroom for scaling.

Sam: Sounds large — cost tradeoff for wasted IPs? Also need to request ENI quota increase per account.

Maya: Yes, but ENI/secondary IP limits are the real friction. We also need more public IPs for NAT egress if they want per-tenant static egress. Ask cloud provider for 200 EIPs per region initially.

CloudOps Bot: Created support case AWS#768192 with subject 'EIP quota increase for tenant Orion' — case link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#768192

Infra SRE: For PrivateLink endpoints: request for Interface endpoints for S3, STS not needed if VPC gateway endpoints used, but we'll need Interface endpoints for our telemetry and KMS. Request 50 interface endpoints quota in each region. Also need VPCE service quota for our control plane (cross-account) — check marketplace/private service setup.

Raj: Peering notes — partner VPC has CIDR 10.41.0.0/16. No overlap with our proposed 10.40.0.0/16 so OK. They want transitive access to analytics VPC across peering? Peering doesn't support transitive routing — we'll need TGW or DataShare.

Priya: If they need partner access, suggest using a Transit Gateway hub in their org and create attachments from both VPCs. That requires TGW attachments quota bump and associated route table capacity. Also consider using VPC endpoint services (PrivateLink) for specific APIs if we only need limited connectivity.

Maya: Security constraints: customer requires KMS control and HSM-backed CMKs for model keys. Need to confirm our Private deployment supports HSM integration in eu-west1. Also audit logging must go to their S3 via gateway endpoint.

Sam: For GPU quota requests I can file tickets to AWS and GCP if they want multi-cloud. Do we want spot/interruptible for burst capacity? Cost-wise it helps but not allowed for SLA workloads.

Maya: Plan: reserve 64 A100s as on-demand dedicated capacity, allow 32 additional as spot-backed burst for non-SLA batch jobs. Create request tickets for the following quotas:
- A100 80GB quota: us-west3 = 96, eu-west1 = 32
- ENI/secondary IP per instance family: increase to support target node counts (attach required numbers in ticket)
- Elastic IPs: 200 per region (us-west3, eu-west1)
- Interface VPC endpoints quota: 50 per region
- TGW attachments: +5

Priya: Also request increased DescribeNetworkInterfaces API rate limits for large clusters — we've hit throttles before during scale. Add that to tickets.

CloudOps Bot: Support case AWS#768193 opened for 'ENI and network API rate limit increase'

Raj: Can we fallback to smaller GPU types if quota is delayed? E.g., A100-40 or H100? Need to validate model perf. Also some regions have spot scarcity.

Maya: Good idea. Add fallback plan: if A100-80 quota delayed, we will provision A100-40 with kernel tuning, and enable cross-region routing to eu-west1 for overflow. Documented in onboarding runbook.

Sam: Action items:
- Sam: file cloud quota increase tickets (A100, EIPs, ENIs, VPCE, TGW) — target today
- Priya: finalize subnet CIDR and send template to customer for peering/TGW decisions
- Raj: validate fallback GPU image configs and perf delta for their top-3 models
- Maya: collect legal/CMK/HSM requirements and push to security for review

Priya: Ping me with the exact counts for ENI/ip so I can include in the request flows. I'll also add a note about reserving secondary IPs on launch templates.

Maya: Thanks — I'll drop exact node counts and expected pods per node by EOD. :thumbsup:

CloudOps Bot: Updated ticket AWS#768192 status: awaiting quota approval from AWS.

Sam: I'll share ticket numbers here once created. If anyone sees a better CIDR suggestion to reduce waste, mention it now.

Raj: No objections, just ensure we document flow for peering vs PrivateLink choices.

Maya: Closing loop — will post the onboarding runbook link once tickets are up.
